readme_markdown:
# URL Shortener

Links may now carry an optional future `expires_at`. Expired links respond with 404 and do not increment the click count.

Run: `SHORTENER_DB_PATH=/tmp/shortener.db BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000 uvicorn app.main:app`
Test: `python -m pytest -q tests`
api_markdown:
# API

- `POST /api/links` `{url, custom_alias?, expires_at?}`
- `GET /r/{code}` -> 302, 404 if expired, 404 if unknown
- `GET /api/links/{code}/stats` now includes expires_at and status
limitations: Expiry is per-link only, no bulk/campaign expiry.
summary: Added optional per-link expiry via an additive migration; expired links return 404.
